mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.code, r.data_scope FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1
SELECT role_id, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM sys_user_role GROUP BY role_id
SELECT r.name FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.sort, r.id
